verdict.label: STEP ASIDE — DXY Clears 100; CPI Tomorrow Is the Sole Circuit-Breaker
verdict.rationale_short: The morning STEP ASIDE call was correct: Nasdaq fell 0.97%, AAPL dropped 3.6%, and MU's dead-cat reversed sharply intraday (-8.6% from Monday close). DXY clearing below 100 (to 99.73) is the first constructive regime signal since the NFP shock, but VIX remains above 18, SPX is 73 points below the 7,460 regime floor, and May CPI tomorrow at 8:30 AM ET is a live binary. Adding directional risk ahead of the print is poor risk management regardless of Thursday's DXY improvement.

bear_case: DXY clearing below 100 removes one of five regime triggers, and Brent at $91.11 has created a $5.89 buffer from the $97 oil threshold — the two most acute tail risks from last week are materially reduced. CNN Fear & Greed at 43 (Fear) is a contrarian signal: markets down only 0.26% on a day the VIX spiked to 20.45 intraday may reflect underlying resilience, not distribution. If CPI prints ≤3.7% YoY with core ≤0.2% m/m Wednesday, the 30Y rallies through 4.95%, VIX collapses below 17, and SPX reclaims 7,460 in a single session — triggering a multi-day short-covering squeeze toward 7,550+. **Invalidation: if CPI prints ≤3.7% YoY on June 10, STEP ASIDE converts to HOLD immediately and the NVDA $195-210 re-entry zone reopens; a ≤3.5% print upgrades HOLD to BUY. If SPX closes above 7,460 on CPI day, QQQ shorts are covered without hesitation.**
